actual_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE full-body transparent visual-novel anger sprite of Mitya from Genshin Impact. Preserve his silver-white wavy hair, violet iris design, white cravat and atom pendant, navy-purple coat with gold orbital ornamentation, turquoise tassels and lining, fitted trousers and purple-cuffed black-gold boots. Retain his petite slender Medium Male anime proportions, at least as compact as the approved neutral, with no elongated torso or legs. Exactly two arms, two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet separated or only slightly staggered; no crossed legs or extreme foreshortening. Keep one coherent mouth. Entire silhouette, hair, cape or coat tails, both hands where visible and both boot soles inside frame; 92–96 percent visible height with 2–4 percent top/bottom padding. One isolated character on genuine transparent alpha. No scenery, props, weapons, floor, cast shadow, UI, labels, watermark, floating symbols or effects.
